steps.name: 겹침 순서만 바꾼 저장(다른 창) → 변경 탭에 '요소 순서'(원장에 변경으로 남는다)
steps.js: const r=await fetch('/api/deck/lordtest',{cache:'no-store'});const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version');const d=await r.json();d.slides[0].elements.reverse();const p=await fetch('/api/deck/lordtest?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)});if(!p.ok)return 'put '+p.status;document.querySelector('[data-tab="chg"]').click();await until(async()=>(/요소 순서/.test((document.querySelector('#chgList')||document.body).textContent)),10000);const t=document.body.textContent;return /요소 순서/.test(t)?true:'변경 탭에 요소 순서 없음';
